description: Two-peer version_metadata exchange.  Each side sends its 'meta' preamble + signed handshake body, the other side verifies the ed25519 signature over blake2b-keyed(password)(pubkey), and both end up with peer pubkeys.  This is the first frame any peer link exchanges.  Then A sends a root announce -- A as its own parent, self-signed.  This is what a newly-self-rooting node broadcasts.

frames.comment: A's handshake meta.  Layout: 4-byte 'meta' preamble + uint16 BE body length + TLV body (major+minor+pubkey+priority) + 64-byte ed25519 signature.  Signature is over blake2b-keyed(empty_password)(A_pubkey).
B's handshake reply -- same layout, B's pubkey, B's ed25519 signature.  Both sides may send concurrently; the order in this scenario is canonical-A-first but the protocol doesn't care.

RouterAnnounce(key=A, parent=A, ...)  -- A as its own root.  Body: 32-byte key + 32-byte parent + sig_res(seq, nonce, port=0, psig) + 64-byte ed25519 signature.  B's handle_announce verifies both signatures (key signs + parent signs, same since A==parent) then update_info accepts.

name: handshake_then_announce
